update.reason: Use the upstream mirror for release tags; recipe inputs come from the official musl release archive. New releases must apply the policy patch and pass the resolver probes.

hardening.minimized_reason: Retain the full musl ABI. The APK ships only the shared runtime, with no headers, static archives or compiler wrappers.
hardening.pledge_reason: The resolver binding change does not implement a capability policy; service confinement remains in Werewolf forms.

changes.what: An opt-in musl shared runtime with the upstream CVE-2026-107891 fix and loopback-bound UDP resolver sockets when all configured IPv4 nameservers are loopback.
changes.why: Programs using musl with Werewolf’s local DNS proxy need no externally bound DNS socket. A private install path lets forms adopt this without replacing the system libc.

wolfi.removal_condition: Upstream musl provides equivalent local resolver socket binding and a maintained runtime suitable for these forms.
